Description

Seemingly carved from a dark green stone, this sinister crouching humanoid resembles a horned, winged demon. Usually leads a pack of gargoyles with them.

Defense

AC 22, touch 11; flat-footed 20 (+2 dex, +11 natural, -1 size)

hp 115 [160] (10d10+60)

Fort +9, Ref +9, Will +8

DR 10/cold iron

Resist Earth 15, Lightning 50%

Weakness Wind

Offense

Speed 40 ft., Fly 60 ft. (average)

Melee 2 Claws +15 (1d8+6), Bite +15 (1d8+6), Gore +15 (1d8+6)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Bloody Claw, Snatch, Triumphant Roar

Statistics

Str 22, Dex 15, Con 22, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 8

Base Atk +10; CMB +17; CMD 29

Feats Bloody Assault, Cleave, Death from Above, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Fly)

Skills Fly +19, Perception +15, Stealth +15 (+19 in stony areas); Racial Modifier +2 Stealth (+6 in stony environments)

Languages Common, Terran

SQ Freeze

description.value:
Sacrificing accuracy, you can inflict bloody wounds that are slow to heal.

Prerequisites: Str 13, Power Attack, base attack bonus +6.

Benefits: You can choose to take a -5 penalty on all melee attack rolls and combat maneuver checks to inflict 1d4 points of bleed damage with your weapon melee attacks, in addition to the normal damage dealt by the weapon. A creature continues to take bleed damage every round at the start of its turn. Bleed damage can be stopped by a DC 15 Heal check or through any magical healing. Bleed damage from this feat does not stack with itself. You must choose to use this feat before making the attack roll, and its effects last until your next turn (although the bleeding lasts until healed, as normal).

Combat Trick

Each round you use this feat, you can spend up to 5 stamina points. If you do, until the end of your next turn, you reduce the penalty on all your attack rolls by an amount equal to the number of stamina points you spent.

description.value:
You allow gravity to add extra force to your charges.

Benefits: Whenever you charge an opponent from higher ground, or from above while flying, you gain a +5 bonus on attack rolls in place of the bonuses from charging and being on higher ground.

Combat Trick

When charging an opponent from higher ground or from above while flying, you can spend 4 stamina points to gain a +5 bonus on the damage roll, and also retain the bonuses from charging and being on higher ground.

description.value: 3/day, a belphegor forms a crimson claw draining the life force from their target with a melee touch attack (+15). If it hits, the target takes 3d6 points of shadow damage and the belphegor is healed for that much. The victim also takes 1 point of ability damage to a random stat (1d6): 1 for Strength, 2 for Dexterity, 3 for Constitution, 4 for Intelligence, 5 for Wisdom, or 6 for Charisma. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd-level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 21).

effect: Heal actual damage, then [[1d6]] for one point of ability damage: Str/Dex/Con/Int/Wis/Cha.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 3rd-level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 21).

description.value: A belphegor can hold itself so still, it appears to be a statue. A belphegor that uses freeze can take 20 on its Stealth check to hide in plain sight as a stone statue.

A belphegor can start a grapple when it hits with both claw attacks, as though it had the grab ability. If it grapples a creature of size Medium or smaller, it squeezes each round for automatic claw damage with a successful grapple check. A belphegor can fly while holding a creature that weighs 350 pounds or less. It cannot throw creatures it is carrying, but can drop them as a free action.

effect: Both claws must hit. Hold at most 350 lb in flight; drop freely, never throw.
Grappled Medium or smaller only, after a successful grapple check.
